description: Start here when the user has finished building an Android or iOS app and wants to publish it, or asks for Play Store / App Store help with an app that is waiting in review, was rejected, or is live and needs an update. Connects the app project once and analyzes it (manifest, Gradle, Info.plist, strings, README, icons, screenshots) for store-review problems and launch readiness. No tokens or forms. source: "github" (public repo URL), "path" (a project folder or .zip on the machine running this server), or "sample" (built-in demo app SnapLedger). Returns project_id used by every other Rocket Launcher tool.

github_url.description: Public GitHub repo URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo (optionally /tree/branch/subfolder). Required when source=github

lang.description: Language for texts in the result: en (default), ko, th, zh (Simplified Chinese), hi (Hindi). Pass the user's language.

path.description: Absolute path to the project folder or a .zip of it, on the computer running this MCP server. Required when source=path

store_stage.description: Where the app is now, only if the user said so: one stage for every store, or per store {play, apple}. not_submitted = first submit, in_review = uploaded and waiting, rejected = rejected, live = already published (this is an update). If omitted, ask the user (decision key stage:<store>).

name: rocketlauncher_connect_app
title: Connect an app (start launch help)
